hero: A local repair garage interior: a car on a lift, a diagnostic cart with a glowing blank screen, stacked winter tires; through a high window, a bay, a mountain and the sea in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#262626), accent highlights (#ff2f72), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers.
